Escape from Colony 8
====================

I can't really tell what happened, when they first attacked our base or where
they came from, but Colony 8 is lost. My only chance is to get to hangar
and escape from this nightmare. I just hope my combat suit will be strong enough!

This is a game for the ZX Spectrum 48k (and 128K).

Default keys (can be redefined):

 - left: o
 - right: p
 - up: q
 - down: a
 - fire: space

Hold fire for some seconds to load a missile (requires ammo), release
fire to launch it.

Use backspace to exit the game, 'h' to pause.

Game updates from:

 http://www.usebox.net/jjm/colony8/
